preconditions.description: The dimensions n, m, number of levels k, and weight w are within specified bounds.

postconditions.description: The first line of the output is the minimum number of transferred bytes.
The second line contains k pairs of integers describing the transfer method for each level.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= k and (y == 0 or (1 <= y < x)) for x, y in return_value[1])
postconditions.description: Each pair (x_i, y_i) satisfies the constraints: 1 <= x_i <= k and (y_i == 0 or (1 <= y_i < x_i)).
